Cabela's Outdoor Adventures.name: Cabela's Outdoor Adventures
Cabela's Outdoor Adventures.summary: The game features North America's top outdoor destinations, over 50 hunting and fishing adventures and intensive use of gear and tactics, such as animal calls and stealth skills. Emphasis is placed on moments that are instinctively associated with hunting and fishing, like deer stalking, squeezing the trigger, hooking a fish or snap-shooting a flushed bird, all while respecting real life hunting rules and regulations.

Hakuouki - Junsouroku.name: Hakuoki: Stories of the Shinsengumi
Hakuouki - Junsouroku.summary: Remaster of the first base game, Hakuoki ~Shinsengumi Kitan~, and it's fan disc, Hakuoki ~Zuisouroku~, from PlayStation 2. Six character paths available.

LEGO Star Wars - The Complete Saga.name: LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga
LEGO Star Wars - The Complete Saga.summary: Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga is a Lego-themed action-adventure game with platforming and puzzle-solving, played from a third-person perspective in a world built from Lego pieces. It combines and updates the content of two earlier games, Lego Star Wars: The Video Game and Lego Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy, covering the six films of the Skywalker Saga across dozens of story levels. Players take on many different characters, each with distinct abilities such as lightsabers and the Force for Jedi and Sith, or blasters and grappling hooks for others, and use those abilities to progress and reach hidden areas. It supports drop-in co-op play, a Cantina hub world for free roaming and character customization, a Free Play mode for replaying levels, and a large amount of collectibles to gather.

MXGP - The Official Motocross Videogame.name: MXGP: The Official Motocross Videogame
MXGP - The Official Motocross Videogame.summary: The only official MXGP videogame: all the riders and bikes from MX1 and MX2! Race on 1:1 scale official championship tracks. Career mode takes you from Debut Season to MX1. The game physics and dual stick control allow for separate control of bike and rider: unprecedented realism, in your hands.

One Piece - Unlimited World Red.name: One Piece: Unlimited World RED
One Piece - Unlimited World Red.summary:
One Piece: Unlimited World Red is an Action/Adventure video game based on the famous One Piece manga and anime.

This is the thirty-sixth video game based on the series, and the fifth title in the Unlimited sub-series. It was released for the Nintendo 3DS in Japan on November 21, 2013 and released for additional platforms and in more regions the following year.

Skylanders - SuperChargers.name: Skylanders: SuperChargers
Skylanders - SuperChargers.summary:
Kick your adventure into overdrive! The Skylanders SuperChargers Portal Owner’s Pack includes the full video game, works with any Portal of Power from the Skylanders series and includes Instant Spitfire and Instant Hot Streak. Expand your gameplay experience with over 40 Skylanders and vehicles to collect.

Skylands is in peril! Kaos has unleashed his most evil weapon yet – the Doomstation of Ultimate Doomstruction. With all of Skylands on the verge of collapse, a special team called the SuperChargers has been assembled to pilot an unstoppable fleet of incredible vehicles. Now you and the SuperChargers must embark on epic adventures over land, under sea, and through the sky to stop Kaos and save Skylands!

Star Wars - The Force Unleashed.name: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed
Star Wars - The Force Unleashed.summary:
Star Wars: The Force Unleashed is a Star Wars video game that takes place between the films Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith and Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope. It is the centerpiece of the Star Wars: The Force Unleashed multimedia project,

Star Wars: The Force Unleashed completely re-imagines the scope and scale of the Force and casts players as Darth Vader’s "Secret Apprentice," unveiling new revelations about the Star Wars galaxy seen through the eyes of a mysterious new character armed with unprecedented powers.

The game showcases Digital Molecular Matter (DMM), an extremely detailed and realistic material physics engine developed by Pixelux, and Euphoria, a realistic bio-mechanical A.I. engine by NaturalMotion

Super Hero Generation.name: Super Hero Generation
Super Hero Generation.summary: Super Hero Generation is a tactical role-playing game that brings together heroes and villains from the Gundam, Kamen Rider, and Ultraman series. Travel between connected worlds, deploy characters on grid-based battlefields, and complete mission objectives before facing powerful enemies in turn-based combat.
